text:
Type: metal and glass shelving unit
Use: displaying books, plants and decor, dividing a room; living room, home office, dining room
Style: industrial, modern, minimalist
Materials: black-brown powder-coated steel frame, tempered glass shelves, wood-effect bottom shelf
Colors: dark black-brown, clear glass
Shape: tall wide open grid of thin square tubes with a center divider, glass shelves on several levels, solid bottom shelf, open back and sides, airy and see-through
Feel: graphic, light, urban, tidy
Goes with: dark wood, concrete, leather, brass or black accents, green plants; industrial or modern lofts

product.name: VITTSJ
product.description: Tempered glass and metal are durable materials that provide an open, airy feel.
